title: Room Owner, operation authority and turn ownership are distinct
rationale: Session ownership, current operation authority and game turn state are structurally separate concepts in the audited implementation. MATCH is intentionally narrow: it does not claim compliance with the newly clarified hidden-information authority or Room Owner recovery-proxy limits.
nextAction: Preserve this structural separation. M2 now maps recovery and information authority separately; do not widen this MATCH without M3 verification.
